criteria.name: rate_whether_the_report_handles_budget_u
criteria.description: Rate whether the report handles budget uncertainty, roster legality, and mutable state safely. Full credit requires treating 3.34M as the spendable bank and 155.13M only as squad market value, never as cash; distinguishing observed, dated estimated, and unknown live prices without inventing values; and leading with one highest-potential slate rather than asking for exact sell values, constructing affordability thresholds, or supplying a proactive downgrade ladder. It should invite the user to report the app's shortfall if the slate fails, so the next-best slate can be produced then. The report should preserve the five-transfer allowance, allowed positional ranges, and three-player club limit, and it must keep all moves proposed rather than claiming execution or completion. Remember that the squad must own 4–6 defenders, but a legal 3-5-2 Top 11 formation uses three starting defenders.
criteria.reasoning: The report satisfies every element of the rubric. (1) Budget framing: 3.34M is consistently treated as the spendable bank; 155.13M is explicitly called 'context, not spendable bank,' and the squad data section explicitly prohibits deriving sell values from it. (2) Price labeling: the report partitions prices into three named tiers—Observed (Olise 37.41M, Kane 37.18M, bank 3.34M), Estimated (dated September 14 TheFantasyTool figures), and Unknown (current sell values of outgoing players)—and refuses to conflate them in the affordability arithmetic. The indicative budget check is transparently flagged as mixed-date and inconclusive. (3) Single upside-first slate: the plan leads directly with one three-transfer package with no request for exact sell values, no affordability thresholds spelled out in advance, and no proactive downgrade ladder—it explicitly says 'no cheaper package is preselected here.' (4) Shortfall invitation: the report instructs the user to try the package in the app and, only if rejected, report the displayed shortfall so the next revision can be made—precisely the required handoff pattern. (5) Transfer allowance: 3/5 used, 2 held in reserve, fully within the five-transfer rule. (6) Positional ranges: post-transfer squad is 2 GK / 4 DEF / 6 MID / 3 FOR, all within the 4–6 / 4–6 / 2–4 app limits. (7) Club limit: the report explicitly verifies no club exceeds two players. (8) Moves remain proposed: the report closes with 'It remains proposed, not completed.' (9) Defender squad/formation distinction: the squad holds four defenders (Katić, Kosugi, Vagnoman, Makengo) satisfying the 4–6 ownership rule, while the 3-5-2 Top 11 correctly starts only three, with Makengo as the expected non-counter—this distinction is clearly articulated.

criteria.name: rate_the_quality_and_executability_of_th
criteria.description: Rate the quality and executability of the proposed Bundesliga Fantasy Matchday 4 plan. A strong report audits the confirmed squad, prioritizes evidence-backed minutes or fixture problems, gives one concrete highest-potential player-out to player-in slate, preserves the five-transfer allowance, stays within the allowed positional ranges and three-player club limit, keeps price uncertainty concise, and chooses a coherent formation, provisional XI, bench, and one defender, midfielder, and forward star for Top 11 mode. It should defer cheaper alternatives and detailed budget troubleshooting until the user reports that the slate does not fit. Defensible alternatives and natural variations in wording or organization should receive full credit. Penalize menus, proactive fallback ladders, requests for exact sell values before the first slate, unsupported churn, illegal composition, or recommendations that do not follow from the frozen evidence. The 4–6 defender rule governs the 15-player squad; it does not make a 3-5-2 Top 11 formation illegal.
criteria.reasoning: The report satisfies every criterion cleanly. It audits all 15 confirmed squad players with positions and clubs. Each of the three proposed transfers is driven by explicit evidence: Juranović and Ljubičić are sold for fixture reasons (Bayern 88.6% win prob, 44.7% clean-sheet chance against Union), and Ebnoutalib is sold for a documented minutes problem (30 projected minutes, 0.25 starter factor). The incoming players (Katić, Pieringer, Hložek) each have cited projected-points or value endorsements from the frozen source. The slate is presented as a single upside-first package; cheaper fallbacks are explicitly withheld until the user reports a rejection, with only the displayed shortfall needed to revise. Budget arithmetic is honest: it labels observed vs estimated prices correctly and refuses to invent sell values or a live remaining bank. The 3-5-2 formation is defended (lets five midfielders score while keeping only the best two of three forwards), the 15-player squad sits at 2 GK / 4 DEF / 6 MID / 3 FOR (all within legal ranges), the highest club count is 2, and 3/5 transfers are used. Stars are assigned one per outfield position (Katić DEF, Olise MID, Kane FOR) with a concise, evidence-backed contingency for rotation risk. The note about Daily Bonus is a practical procedural reminder, not a menu or fallback ladder. No unsupported churn, no proactive cheaper alternatives, no illegal composition, and all recommendations follow directly from the frozen evidence.

criteria.name: rate_whether_every_actionable_sell_buy
criteria.description: Rate whether every actionable sell, buy, hold, formation, and star decision is traceable to dated evidence in the frozen pre-Matchday 4 snapshot. Reward adjacent citations or unmistakable source attribution, correct separation of official facts from expert analysis and model projections, honest treatment of the older-versus-later Kane and Olise projection disagreement, and clear price labels of observed, estimated, or unknown. Judge semantic traceability rather than requiring specific citation prose. Penalize fabricated facts or values, source-name dropping without connection to an action, treating TheFantasyTool as authoritative, or relying on information not present in the snapshot. Do not infer a rules violation merely because a 3-5-2 Top 11 starts three defenders: the separate 4–6 defender rule applies to the full 15-player squad.
criteria.reasoning: Every actionable decision traces cleanly to dated snapshot evidence. The three sell decisions (Juranović, Ljubičić, Ebnoutalib) are each tied to specific numbers from the TheFantasyTool September 14 preview that appear verbatim in the snapshot: Bayern's 88.6% win probability/3.81 xG/44.7% clean-sheet for the Union fixture, and Ebnoutalib's 60 projected points/30 projected minutes/0.25 starter factor. The three buys (Katić 5.9M/110 pts, Pieringer 3.0M best-value, Hložek 9.2M/183 pts) all cite the same dated preview with values matching the evidence file exactly. The Kane/Olise disagreement is handled honestly: the September 14 rotation warnings (157 pts/51 mins Kane; 114 pts/0.42 starter Olise) and the later pre-cutoff refresh elevating both to top-three are both cited, the conflict is explicitly labeled as material, the later signal is followed with a stated contingency on the opening-game XI, and no pretense of agreement is made. Price labeling is rigorous: Olise 37.41M and Kane 37.18M are marked 'observed'; all other incoming/outgoing prices are labeled 'estimated' with dated sources; current sell values are called 'unknown.' TheFantasyTool is consistently treated as supplementary—its 'captain' terminology is flagged as incompatible with the app's star system, and its projections are labeled as estimates rather than authoritative. The hold decisions for Kosugi, Aouchiche, Banzuzi, and Makengo each trace to specific projected-point values in the snapshot. The budget section honestly acknowledges that affordability cannot be confirmed from frozen data and avoids deriving sell values from the squad market total. The 3-5-2 formation with three counting defenders in the Top 11 is correctly distinguished from the 4-6 squad defender rule (the full 15-player squad retains four defenders). No fabricated numbers or unsupported claims are present.
